Research

My research interests span reinforcement learning, algorithms, multimodal learning, and computer vision. I focus on efficient LLM training and problems where better algorithms can reduce the data and computation needed to train large models.

Research Interests

  • Reinforcement learning: policy optimization for language-model reasoning
  • Efficient training: fewer optimizer steps and lower wall-clock time
  • Multimodal learning: vision-language models and medical AI
  • Computer vision: medical image analysis and polyp segmentation

Efficient LLM Training

PrePO predicts a farther point on a same-batch optimization trajectory from two observed updates, then repositions and corrects. The work matches baseline performance with fewer explicit optimization steps and less wall-clock time in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

Undergraduate Thesis

Implementation and Performance Analysis of a Hybrid CNN–Transformer Model for Polyp Image Segmentation

Designed a hybrid architecture for 2D polyp image segmentation, combining spatial-context preservation blocks with a Transformer-based decoder. The analysis examined how each architectural component contributed to segmentation performance. Related work: Trans-SPAnet.

Projects

Bangla OCR: Progressive Training of a Compact VLM

Qwen3-VL · GRPO · vLLM · Jun 2025 – Present

  • Built a Bangla document OCR model for handwritten and printed text using progressive vision-language alignment, supervised OCR, and reinforcement learning with text-accuracy rewards.
  • Created an automated data engine using multi-model consensus, synthetic degraded pages, and image-to-image self-verification.
  • Served the model with vLLM and added PyTorch and ONNX deployment backends.

Multimodal RAG Assistant for Scientific Papers

Gemini File Search · LangGraph · RAG

  • Designed a multimodal retrieval pipeline over PDFs that uses text, tables, and figures and grounds answers in cited source passages.
  • Built a LangGraph agent to route queries to paper summaries, targeted questions, or citation lookup.
  • Added persistent multi-session chat and per-user document libraries.

Image-to-Drawing CNC Plotter

Arduino · G-code · Stepper motors

  • Built an image-to-paper drawing machine with stepper motors for the X and Y axes and a servo to raise and lower the pen.
  • Converted images to vector toolpaths and G-code; simulated the circuit in Proteus before assembly.

FPGA-Based Arithmetic Logic Unit

Verilog · Quartus · Altera FPGA

  • Designed a multi-bit ALU supporting arithmetic, logic, and shift operations with carry, zero, and overflow flags.
  • Verified through waveform simulation, synthesized in Quartus, and tested on an Altera FPGA board.
